metadata.description: Multi-plugin toolkit providing reusable agent rules, skills, and workflows for AI coding agents

plugins.name: agent-core
plugins.description: Core development principles and workflows: dynamic discovery, documentation standards, TDD cycle, and PR creation

plugins.name: stack-pnpm-monorepo
plugins.description: pnpm workspace and monorepo management: shared package boundaries, workspace protocol, cache and build isolation

plugins.name: stack-nestjs
plugins.description: NestJS Clean Architecture: layered boundaries, dependency inversion, DI patterns, and naming conventions

plugins.name: stack-web-apps
plugins.description: Frontend web application architecture: SPA/SSR/PWA design, React components, custom hooks, context providers, and naming conventions

plugins.name: stack-trpc
plugins.description: tRPC end-to-end type safety: shared type stubs, satisfies router pattern, client generation, and input validation

plugins.name: stack-docker-db
plugins.description: Docker and database management: DDL design, migration numbering, schema management, and local container lifecycle
